tex_content.label: prop:distance-preserving-map-linear-isometry
tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch2:2-2

Let $V,W$ be finite-dimensional real inner product spaces of equal dimension. If $F:V\to W$ satisfies $F(0)=0$ and $|F(x)-F(y)|=|x-y|$ for all $x,y$, then $F$ is a linear isometry.
